children: Power Corp. of Canada-backed Envocore secured a 129 million Canadian dollar (US$92.8 million) water meter modernization contract in Puerto Rico.

Envocore, a portfolio company of Power Corp.'s Power Sustainable subsidiary, will under the five-year contract support the island-wide replacement of about 1.5 million ultrasonic water meters and the deployment of advanced metering infrastructure endpoints.
The program is expected to provide Puerto Rico Aqueduct and Sewer Authority with more timely and accurate information regarding water consumption across its system.
Power Sustainable invested in Envocore in January.
